# LanguageInstanceEditor

**Class** · namespace `VRFramework.Core.Editors` · assembly `VRFramework.Core.Editors` · [view source](https://git.cie-group.cz/vr-framework/vrf4/core/-/blob/main/Editor/Language/LanguageInstanceEditor.cs#L18)

Shared editor for the three localization instance assets.

These stay single-object on purpose. Their content is the translation arrays, and Unity
can only show the first selected asset's array, so a multi-object inspector here would
show one asset's entries while appearing to edit all of them.

```csharp
public abstract class LanguageInstanceEditor : VRFComponentEditor
```
